title: 21.8 to 1 significant figure
caption: To one significant figure 21.8 rounds to a multiple of 10. It is nearer 20 than 30 (the halfway point is 25), so it rounds to 20, the first step of the estimate (20 × 5) ÷ 0.2.
alt: A number line from 10 to 30 with 21.8 marked, closer to 20 than to 30, and the halfway point 25 dashed.
description: The candidates are the multiples of 10 either side: 20 and 30.
The halfway point between them is 25.
21.8 is below 25, so it rounds down to 20.
